title: CPF Module Schema: Stream Analytics Cluster module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-streamanalyticscluster'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
prerequisites: Key Vault and associated Private Endpoint

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

managed_private_endpoint.type: map(object({ private_endpoint_name = string target_resource_id = string subresource_name = string }))
managed_private_endpoint.description: (Optional) manage private endpoint configuration object({ private_endpoint_name = "(Required) The name which should be used for this Stream Analytics Managed Private Endpoint. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." target_resource_id = "(Required) The ID of the Private Link Enabled Remote Resource which this Stream Analytics Private endpoint should be connected to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." subresource_name = "(Required) Specifies the sub resource name which the Stream Analytics Private Endpoint is able to connect to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." })

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

streaming_capacity.description: (Required) The number of streaming units supported by the Cluster. Accepted values are multiples of 36 in the range of 36 to 216

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The resource ID of the stream analytics service.

managed_private_endpoint_id.description: The Stream Analytics Managed Private Endpoint resource ID.

managed_private_endpoint_name.description: The Stream Analytics Managed Private Endpoint resource name.

managed_private_endpoint_resource.description: The Stream Analytics Managed Private Endpoint resource.

name.description: The name of the stream analytics cluster.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Streamanalyticscluster' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
prerequisite_modules: Key Vault and associated Private Endpoint
